body.objective: Proof-first minimal observer extension: classify whether adding exactly one complementary-degree conjugate pair to the frozen 108-row Berger carrier can realize a nondegenerate cyclic pairing and one declared action whose regenerated q1/q2 Ward orbit removes the certified holonomy H=2 obstruction.
body.stop_condition: Define a complete bounded 110-row extension ansatz with pinned degrees, Berger/residual representation, pairing, action terms, and admissible field redefinitions. Prove its compatibility equations and classify their solution locus. Then regenerate q1 and q2 from every surviving action class and independently substitute them into the original common-action Ward verifier, including tau_star and decisive mutations. Land either one certified 110-row common-action extension, a scoped minimal no-go with its first obstruction, or a precise typed Forge capability shortfall; a Conflux candidate is never sufficient by itself.
body.current_gate: minimal 110-row conjugate-pair action extension or exact no-go
body.forbid: no modification of frozen 108-row coefficients disguised as an extension; no fitted cancellation of tau_star; no incomplete extension ansatz called minimal; no Conflux until the observer consumer gate lands and reproduces the known obstruction; no q3, detector, causal, branch, particle, positivity, or quantum promotion
activates: a regenerated common-action observer carrier through arity two, or a higher minimal-dimension obstruction theorem
later q3 only through a new ticket
body.resource_hint: SECOND OBSERVER PROOF-FIRST CASE. Begin from the certified holonomy theorem, not coefficient search. Conflux is optional only after sf:forge-request/conflux-observer-common-action-compatibility lands and independently passes its consumer gate.
notes: Mathematical target: the minimal nondegenerate cyclic extension of the frozen 108-row common-action carrier compatible with declared gradings and Berger symmetry.

Candidate theorem: 109 rows are impossible by odd antisymmetric degeneracy; within one complete bounded 110-row conjugate-pair ansatz, either a common-action compatibility locus exists and is classified or a new invariant obstruction forces a larger carrier/action change.

Proof obligations: pin complementary degrees and representation, classify invariant pairings and admissible action monomials, quotient field redefinitions, derive Ward equations, and prove completeness of the bounded ansatz before solving it.

Counterexample strategy: recover the frozen H=2 obstruction when the auxiliary pair decouples; reject any proposed action whose regenerated q1/q2 retains tau_star or loses nondegeneracy/cyclicity; mutate each auxiliary coupling independently.

Certificate boundary: success establishes only a LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/REDUCED-MODE arity-two carrier. It does not establish q3, relational detector response, causality, physical branches, particles, or quantum consistency.
